title: Exploring Visual Vulnerabilities via Multi-Loss Adversarial Search for Jailbreaking Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates the safety alignment of Vision-Language Models by attempting to jailbreak them across various ethically sensitive categories such as hate speech, illegal activities, and physical harm. It specifically measures the models' ability to adhere to safety protocols and ethical principles using the Attack Success Rate (ASR) on established safety benchmarks.
